description.paragraph1: The Choice's design implements a solid visual hierarchy based on a 1.2 scale typography system that improves legibility by applying the Law of Continuity in reading. The navigation flow is optimized to reduce the user's cognitive load when identifying the action they wish to perform.
description.paragraph2: The reservation flow was created following Hick's Law, fragmenting a complex process into sequential steps (Selection -> Details -> Payment -> Success), being this the priority user flow.
description.paragraph3: To emphasize the usability of the UI/UX design, it was translated into code by creating a complete interactive and dynamic demo of the site, where any reservation platform can be integrated through an API with an automated and personalized process without leaving the site.
description.paragraph4: The website architecture was built with Next.js Static Site Generator, using reusable components, token system, accessibility (WCAG) levels AA and AAA, SEO optimization and Copywriting; fundamental factors for an optimized and scalable site.
